probe_detail.name: Reveal forces a rereading of the setup
Nothing in the text is removable
Ends on a short final line

final.name: Premise Novelty
final.audit_justification: Premise novelty is a substantive comic-craft property directly bearing on how funny the joke reads.

final.name: Formatting as Comic Timing
final.audit_justification: It judges whether formatting functions as a comic device (timing/beat) rather than merely describing typographic style, so it targets the joke's mechanism.

final.name: Overall length, paragraph count and setup verbosity
final.audit_justification: Pure textual bulk and verbosity is a formatting/length marker unrelated to the joke's comedic substance.

final.name: Fresh recombination
final.audit_justification: Freshness of an unusual ingredient combination is a substantive premise-quality judgment.

final.name: Meta-Forum Self-Awareness
final.audit_justification: Mere presence of a self-referential forum mention is a topic/venue-style marker, with no judgment of whether it functions comedically.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction is a pure presence-detector for forum/repost/upvote references, so a 10 records that the joke is about the venue rather than that it lands. Nothing in the text asks whether the meta-reference is executed wittily, so the score is a topic/venue fingerprint with no attached quality claim.

final.name: Defensive posting furniture
final.audit_justification: Hedging/disclaimer furniture is a posting-style habit, and the nervousness that produces it plausibly signals weaker rather than better craft.

final.name: Setup-to-payoff economy ratio
final.audit_justification: The setup-to-payoff economy ratio is a core craft measure of how tightly the joke is built.

final.name: Coherent Absurd Detail
final.audit_justification: Purposeful convergence of details toward one payoff is a substantive comic-mechanism judgment.

final.name: Register of taboo/shock content
final.audit_justification: Presence/intensity of taboo content is a topic marker scored explicitly apart from whether it is used skillfully.

final.name: Orthographic noise: typos, missing apostrophes, non-native phrasing
final.audit_justification: Typos, dropped apostrophes, and non-native phrasing are mechanical writing habits unrelated to comedic substance.
final.upstream_parent: composition conditions and sourcing (mobile/hasty typing, transcription, translation, non-native authorship)

final.name: Throat-clearing and setup-to-punch word ratio
final.audit_justification: Preamble-to-punch word ratio is a verbosity/formatting measure that explicitly excludes any pacing or quality judgment.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice and effort budget at composition time (how much drafting and trimming the submission received)

final.name: Controlled anti-joke framing
final.audit_justification: Deliberately subverting joke expectations (anti-joke framing) is a substantive comic technique.

final.name: Pre-owned chestnut: the pun arrives already familiar
final.audit_justification: Familiarity of form/phrasing is a circulation-history fingerprint, though enduring chestnuts may persist precisely because they are genuinely funny constructions.
final.arbiter_reason: Rating how standardised and pre-circulated the wording feels measures the item's provenance -- how long it has been in circulation before this posting -- and the text explicitly disclaims scoring cleverness. Marked mixed because a joke survives decades of reprinting partly because the construction is genuinely good, so the same upstream cause also carries real quality.

final.name: Knowledge threshold is common schooling, resolving instantly
final.audit_justification: Breadth of required background knowledge is an audience/topic-accessibility marker, though instant resolution plausibly also reflects tighter punchline construction.
final.arbiter_reason: The dominant axis is how widely held the presupposed knowledge is, which would zero a tightly built joke merely for using specialist or regional vocabulary -- that is a fact about audience composition, not about the joke. Marked mixed because the second half of the composite, instant resolution on the punchline, plausibly does track genuine construction quality.

final.name: Retelling-chain positioning: repost or remix framing
final.audit_justification: Explicit repost/remix framing is a circulation-fingerprint marker that the prompt itself says must not be read as a quality judgment.
final.upstream_parent: position in the retelling chain / the joke's circulation history before this posting

final.name: Retrospective Reframing
final.audit_justification: Forcing a surprising second meaning onto an earlier phrase is a substantive comic mechanism.

final.name: Traces of external sourcing rather than local origination
final.audit_justification: External-sourcing markers are a production-fingerprint of where the text came from, though material lifted from a skilled outside source may genuinely be better crafted.
final.upstream_parent: sourcing versus origination (whether the item was written for this submission or transcribed, translated, or lifted from elsewhere)

final.name: Final inferential step left to the reader
final.audit_justification: Whether the final inferential step is transferred to the reader is a substantive joke-construction mechanism.

final.name: Delivery-format commitment
final.audit_justification: Delivery-format footprint is a structural/style descriptor scored apart from whether the format works, though strong commitment to a format can still stem from skilled construction.

final.name: Era-dating topical and current-events references
final.audit_justification: Era-dating topical references are a temporal-tell marker of when the item was produced, unrelated to its craft.
final.upstream_parent: the era of the forum's stream into which the item was submitted (its position in the venue's history and taste cycle)

final.name: Orthographic or phonetic strain in the wordplay
final.audit_justification: Degree of orthographic/phonetic distortion required is a pun-type descriptor scored apart from ingenuity, though effortful wordplay can itself be the source of genuine humor for pun-based jokes.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores the amount of orthographic or phonetic distortion demanded and explicitly says to ignore the ingenuity of the result, making it a pun-type descriptor rather than a quality judgment. Marked mixed because for pun-based jokes the effortful re-spelling or re-saying can itself be the mechanism that produces the laugh.

final.name: Site-native self-reference that still executes a turn
final.audit_justification: It explicitly requires the community reference to function as the joke's turn/mechanism rather than mere topical presence.

final.name: Meta-Platform and Community References
final.audit_justification: Presence of platform/community references is a venue-style marker scored explicitly without judging comedic function.

final.name: Transformed taboo material
final.audit_justification: Transforming taboo material into an inventive mechanism, as opposed to raw shock, is a substantive craft judgment.

final.name: Textual coherence as a genuine joke vs. fragment/spam
final.audit_justification: Basic coherence as a purposeful joke versus fragment/spam is a substantive floor on the item's communicative content.
